_meta.note: Farm-model values filled in T3-2, and the starting values telemetry needs in T4-5; Track 3 owns this file. None is verified by agronomy yet: each is a placeholder, a virtual-farm prototype value or calibrated to a contract example (see sources). Do not use for a real farm. speedOptions is real (contract 11.4); minRealReadingIntervalS and model.numerics are simulator settings, not farm values.

sources.model.ecPerGramPerL: PLACEHOLDER: k in EC = k*M/V; 1.0 is the Track 3 guide's placeholder. Only k x nutrientGPerMl is observable, so a jar test of each stock fixes the product.
sources.model.rawWater.ecMsCm: PROTOTYPE: virtual-farm runbook, 'raw water is EC 0.3 and pH 7.2'. Measure the SIET supply.
sources.model.rawWater.ph: PROTOTYPE: virtual-farm runbook, 'raw water is EC 0.3 and pH 7.2'. Measure the SIET supply.
sources.model.rawWater.tempC: PLACEHOLDER: no source. Measure the supply water at the polyhouse.
sources.model.doseLines.A.nutrientGPerMl: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: calibrated so contract 6.6's illustrative dose (A 120 + B 120 mL into 936 L) raises EC by about 0.12 mS/cm. Needs a jar test of the real stock.
sources.model.doseLines.A.phChangePerMlPer1000L: PLACEHOLDER: stock A treated as pH-neutral.
sources.model.doseLines.B.phChangePerMlPer1000L: PLACEHOLDER: stock B treated as pH-neutral.
sources.model.doseLines.ACID.nutrientGPerMl: PLACEHOLDER: the acid's own EC contribution is ignored.
sources.model.doseLines.ACID.phChangePerMlPer100: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: contract 6.6, 30 mL acid takes 936 L from pH 6.21 to 6.02 (-0.0059). The runbook's 100 mL story implies about -0.0048. Needs a titration of the SIET water with the real acid.
sources.model.refill: PLACEHOLDER: refill flow through the open valve, no source. Measure at the inlet.
sources.model.phDrift.targetPh: PROTOTYPE: assumes the solution drifts toward the raw water's pH (runbook 7.2).
sources.model.phDrift.timeConstantH: PLACEHOLDER: gives about +0.2 pH per day from 5.8. Agronomy to confirm from farm logs.
sources.model.solutionTemp.airCouplingWPerK: PLACEHOLDER: gives a time constant of about 6 h at 1200 L (4.7 h at 936 L).
sources.model.plantUptake.waterChangePerDegC: PLACEHOLDER: +3 % water uptake per degree C above reference; no source.
sources.model.plantUptake.crops: PLACEHOLDER: Track 3 order-of-magnitude estimate (about 225 plants per bench, 0.15-0.2 L per plant per day when grown), nutrient chosen so EC falls about 0.05 per day at 4 benches. BASIL copies LETTUCE: no crop-specific source. Agronomy to replace.
sources.model.initialState: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: contract 6.1 telemetry example (78 %, EC 1.62, pH 6.04, 23.4 C). Scenarios may override.
sources.model.initialState.dayTankPct: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: contract 6.1 telemetry example (A 64, B 66, ACID 81 %). Scenarios may override. Every installed line needs an entry.
sources.model.initialState.chillerSetpointC: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: contract 6.2 telemetry example (22.0 C). Must lie inside climate.json chillerSetpointC.
sources.model.circulation.flowLpm: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: contract 6.1 telemetry example (31.0 L/min), the flow while the circulation pump runs. Measure at the pump.
sources.model.air: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: contract 6.2 telemetry example. Held constant until a weather model exists (the scenario's region, month and weather). tempByPosC needs an entry for every layout.climate.airSensors position.
sources.model.power: CONTRACT-EXAMPLE: contract 6.3 example (231/229/233 V, UPS 100 %, 42 min). Held constant until the power drills exist (contract 11.4.3).
sources.model.numerics: NUMERICAL: solver settings, not farm values.
sources.minRealReadingIntervalS: NUMERICAL: fewest real seconds between periodic readings, so fast clocks don't flood the broker (T4-7). Not a farm value.
